name: sitespeakai
label: SiteSpeakAI
description: Integrate with Sitespeakai to leverage AI-powered chatbots and enhance user interactions on your website.

token.label: SiteSpeakAI API Key
token.description:
**Enter your SiteSpeakAI API Key.**
---
### How to obtain your API key
1. Sign up / log in at [SiteSpeakAI](https://sitespeak.ai/).
2. Go to **Dashboard → Settings → API Keys**.
3. Generate or copy an API key.
4. Paste it here.

sendQuery.label: Send Query
sendQuery.description: Sends a query to the specified chatbot and retrieves a response.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: The question or query text you want the chatbot to answer.

conversationId.label: Conversation
conversationId.description: Pick a conversation for context, or leave empty to start a new one.

format.label: Response Format
format.description: Format of the returned response; markdown or html.

create_finetune.label: Create Finetune
create_finetune.description: Adds a new fine-tune (question + suggested answer) for the specified chatbot in SiteSpeakAI.

question.label: Question
question.description: The question text you want the chatbot to be able to answer.

suggestedAnswer.label: Suggested Answer
suggestedAnswer.description: The answer you suggest the chatbot use for that question.
